notes.title: Texting feature overview
notes.content:
Today, we're going to talk about a feature that allows you to create closer connections with your companions - texting. In Bloodcrave, you will be able to message your friends and lovers on a regular basis. When you text them, you're able to pick replies and steer the conversation in the direction you desire. 

Those conversations are an excellent way to improve the relationship with them, unlock new events, and, if you play your cards right, you may even get a spicy selfie from them. 

Each love interest will have over 100 potential texting exchanges, and almost every one of them has a branching path, giving you near-endless possibilities in shaping your relationship with them.

Here is a video preview of the feature:
[previewyoutube=I4Bq5Nza6c8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The city of Newport
notes.content:
Welcome to our very first dev blog post, where we'll offer you a behind-the-scenes look at the making of Bloodcrave! Let's begin by exploring the game's central location: the city of Newport.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718228/8df1b54216ff63c15a9cdb657b17fd063fc7d10b.png[/img]

Bloodcrave's action unfolds in the enigmatic city of Newport. We did our best to ensure this location isn't merely a superficial backdrop—Newport boasts a rich history, unique architecture, and fictional brands to bring the city to life. 

Don't worry, though; we won't bombard you with massive lore dumps. Instead, we've carefully woven the city's story through environmental storytelling, incorporating subtle hints in the background art and character conversations. 

We intentionally left Newport's exact location unspecified to avoid association with any specific country. However, when designing its architecture, we took inspiration from cities across the Pacific region, including Singapore, the Gold Coast, and Hong Kong.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718228/884d952eefbbd369e7ad4ff9a35d5df68f9937bb.png[/img]
Newport was established to accommodate the booming international trade of the 20th century, and it quickly became the region's largest port. But as geopolitical tensions rose in the 21st century, causing trade wars, the city's golden years faded. Industries shifted away, causing the economy to falter. Today, Newport is struggling to reinvent itself as a hub for fintech and entertainment companies, but over 30% of its population remains unemployed and dependent on social benefits. 

Unbeknownst to most, this volatile mix of desperation, exploitation, and opportunism has created an ideal breeding ground for vampires. The city has secretly become a fierce battleground for vampire lords, all vying for control. The stage is set—prepare to enter the dark world of Bloodcrave!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718228/35238c0752c85913bc6f717d100c4b286b30920d.png[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Vampire Hunters
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718228/140a4d2836b013daf089482656ec980e5ff355c7.png[/img]
Introducing the team of vampire hunters! With a mysterious benefactor funding their operation, they're making solid progress despite their lack of experience. Expect close calls and plenty of improvisation as they navigate the nocturnal hunting grounds.

[b]Alex [/b]- our protagonist, works as an electronics engineer, but after his first encounter with a vampire, he becomes hooked on adrenaline. He's determined to be in the thick of the action and won't settle for supporting the team from a safe distance.

[b]Kurt [/b]- the team's hacker, always brimming with energy and energy drinks. He cracks jokes and security systems with equal ease, but beware, don't let him get bored, or he will annoy you beyond your limits.

[b]Violet [/b]- a former cop, now the team's primary combat support. Stoic and quiet, she loves sports and is always focused on keeping the team safe through careful planning.

[b]Emily [/b]- the brains behind the operation, running the science and patching-up department. With her keen eye for detail, she helps the team gain the edge by identifying vampires' weak points, and her medical skills keep everyone alive when things get tough.

[b]Chloe [/b]- a petite vampire and the team's main fighter. Despite her reckless tendencies during missions, she can be pretty shy during downtime.
